identity.name: Pilgrim Crab
identity.summary: A rust red crab carrying a tiny cream roadside shrine.
identity.description: Deals 3 physical damage per affordable activation. Starts combat with 5 block; spent block does not refill.
identity.lore: It visits every shrine except the one on its own back.

effects.description: Deals 3 physical damage per affordable activation. Starts combat with 5 block; spent block does not refill.
effects.condition: Equipped; class restriction satisfied; all activation costs can be paid together.

synergies.description: Orthogonal adjacency support and available mana/stamina determine the best arrangement. Strategic combinations grant no unlisted bonus.

conditions: All ingredients are packed, unlocked, nonpermanent and form one orthogonally connected group.
recipes.failureBehavior: Incomplete, disconnected or locked inputs consume nothing. A complete recipe always consumes its inputs; an output that cannot fit enters the stash.
recipes.description: Combine Ironroot Boots, Pearl of Brine, Tin Beetle into Pilgrim Crab.

visual.brief: A rust red crab carrying a tiny cream roadside shrine.
visual.paletteIntent: Restrained material ramps; deliberate spell element colors; no incidental rim light.
definingFeatures: A rust red crab carrying a tiny cream roadside shrine.
